page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Above the text: the running head "TERTIVS." and an ornamental border. No margin notes. Show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed.

head.i: INDEX TERTIUS, UBI ostenditur, in quo doctrina Christianae capite a superioribus haeresibus sit erratum. Omnis autem doctrina Christiana breviter ad haec quatuor capita revocatur, nimirum Decalogum Legis, Symbolum fidei, Orationem Dominicam, & Sacramenta. Ac primum qui in Decalogo Legis errarunt.

main_text.head: DE VERBO DEI scripto.
main_text.p: Verbum Dei scriptum in universum nullam certitudinem habere, sed quemque haereticum recte sentire dicunt Rhetoriani, Lampe-tiani.
Verbum Dei allegoriis prorsus pervertunt Origenista, Nepotiani, Priscilliani.
Revelationes, enthusiasmos & deliria sua pro Dei verbo subiiciunt, & sequuntur Montanista, Pepuziani, Donatista, Enthusiasta, Monachi, Anabaptista.
Traditiones humanas praeferunt Dei verbo Bonosiani.
Traditiones humanas Dei verbo aequant authoritate, & quoad constringendas hominum conscientias, Encratita, Manichaei, Papista.

page.notes: Printed running head "TERTIVS." is given as TERTIUS, following the u/v rule. Ornamental border and show-through text omitted. No page number, catchword or signature is printed. The heading "INDEX TERTIUS" is set as a title (level 1) and "DE VERBO DEI" as a passage title (level 2). Names of heresies and sects are set in italic as printed.
